ops.text: Garman retains ownership of its generic tools and know-how. Garman grants to Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables under this Agreement (including the Modifications) for its business.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Rewriting Garman's ownership sentence is not workable for packaged software, so we have taken our fallback: Garman keeps its generic tools and know-how, and we take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables, including the Modifications, for its business.
proposal.summary: Add a fallback IP clause: Garman keeps generic tools and know-how; Sparkling receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables for its business
